The topic of "Definitional" in this corpus pertains to the precise clinical and administrative definitions of quality indicators and medical codes used in the Danish healthcare system, specifically within acute surgery and patient mobilization. Accurate definitions are critical for measuring healthcare quality, standardizing patient care metrics, and ensuring correct reporting via national databases like the LPR (Landspatientregisteret).

Several key indicators are explicitly defined to track surgical and post-operative outcomes. [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] measures the proportion of patients who undergo surgery within six hours of hospital arrival, specifically calculated among those who are operated on within 24 hours of arrival [^src1]. Similarly, [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] tracks the proportion of patients mobilized within 24 hours post-surgery [^src3]. To ensure consistency in reporting, the definition of mobilization is strictly specified as moving a patient from a lying position to either a sitting or standing position, ensuring they have physically left the bed [^src3].

The corpus also highlights the administrative and coding mechanisms required to track these clinical indicators. For [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] to be measured and reported as a quality indicator, a specific SKS code, [[sks-kode-naaz42|SKS-koden NAAZ42]], was established on October 1, 2022, to indicate that preoperative optimization was performed and registered via the LPR [^src4]. Conversely, the documentation explicitly notes limitations in coding, stating that the SKS code NAAZ4 for 'Anæstesiologisk tilsyn' (Anesthesiological supervision) cannot be used for this specific tracking purpose [^src2]. These definitional boundaries ensure that clinical quality databases accurately reflect intended medical interventions and outcomes without miscoding.

## Claims

- Indikator 5 er defineret som andelen af patienter, der opereres inden for seks timer efter ankomst til sygehus for patienter, der er opereret inden for 24 timer efter ankomst til sygehus [^src1] (indikator-5)
- SKS-koden NAAZ4 'Anæstesiologisk tilsyn' ikke kan bruges til dette [^src1] (sks-kode-naaz42)
- Indikator 6 beskriver andelen af patienter, der mobiliseres indenfor 24 timer efter operation [^src1] (indikator-6)
- Mobilisering er defineret ved mobilisering fra liggende stilling til enten siddende eller stående stilling, hvor patienten har forladt sengen [^src1] (indikator-6)
- Indikator 3 er defineret således at den kan måles og afrapporteres som kvalitetsindikator idet der pr. 1/10-2022 blev oprettet en SKS kode (NAAZ42) til angivelse af at der er udført præoperativ optimering via LPR [^src1] (indikator-3, sks-kode-naaz42)
